knowledge_gaps: The sampling comparison is coherent, and originality 2/10 is reasonable. However, RSS is cited as relevant prior art without an identifiable reference or direct comparison of its target distribution and objective.

Reproducibility still depends on unspecified baseline helpers. Record the actual reconstruction policy, output denominator, optimizer settings, checkpoint-selection rule and validation schedule. Implementation difficulty 3/10 assumes these helpers already support both branches.

Treatment and control coincide for histories with at most 12 events. Report the training-user sampling mass with longer histories in each category; otherwise, a null result could reflect limited treatment exposure.

Potential 6/10 remains speculative. Recent cutoffs change target frequency and context length and may amplify repeated purchases. The report acknowledges these mechanisms but provides no measured exposure distributions or controlled validation results.
The report needs a concrete remaining-budget allocation for both arms across four categories. Research progress of 20% does not establish available GPU time.

Checkpoint selection and repeated validation comparisons can inflate apparent gains. Historical scores lack configuration provenance and uncertainty; a macro difference of 0.0025 represents only two net hits across the 800 validation users.
